detail.title: Autonomous Goal Formation Research Update
detail.summary: This update advances the investigation into autonomous goal formation by proposing a revision to hypothesis h-autonomous-goals-001 to address the non-linear relationship between regularization intensity and objective stability. The experiment exp-autonomous-goals-sim-011 yielded inconclusive results despite satisfying the novelty threshold, necessitating a tighter experimental protocol for subsequent evaluation.
